items.title: Oliver Nelson Jr. interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, September 10, 2020
items.q: I said, “Come to Indianapolis, you record one or two of my Dad’s tunes, and you make sure that SONY”

ctx.x: Yeah, you just might give yourself more headaches.

Oh yeah. And actually I did have one I have to share with you. Bela Fleck, the great banjo player, he did an album called “Out Bound” this was several years ago. So my attorney now went to hear Bela play and they did “Hoedown.” So Aaron Copland’s “Hoedown” is owned by somebody else. So they did [scats] and then in the middle of that hoedown was my Dad’s “Hoedown.” So I said well this is a copyright infringement. So of course the attorneys start calling and two years later I get a call at midnight from Bela in…
Oh. Now that was a civilized way to resolve that situation.
